material_context: The paired fragments represent local chemical structures in cured epoxy materials, not complete polymer networks.
experimental_observations: Cured analogues containing ortho-methoxy groups were reported to have lower dielectric constants than the corresponding non-methoxy materials over the studied frequency/temperature range.
An OH stretching band in the methoxy-containing cured material blue-shifted with increasing temperature; the source comparison without methoxy did not show the same blue shift.
measurement_context: Dielectric tests span kHz–MHz and temperature variation; thermal FTIR uses KBr pellets from25 to125 C. These are bulk material observations, not measured isolated-fragment dipoles.
data_limit: No raw dielectric or thermal-IR spectrum dataset is supplied; no quantitative molecular fit to bulk data is requested.
